cases.rationale: People stand at the right sidewalk, passenger cars occupy the street, and the large dark foreground fixture has the rounded head and dial of a parking meter. The upper-left pole fixture has projecting round lamp-like elements but too little detail to distinguish a traffic signal from another fixture, so traffic light is unclear. The church and neighboring building are architecture; their openings are not screens or appliances. After considering each of the 75 definitions, no other defined object is identifiable.

Two actual people walk by the water on a sandy beach. The broad olive curved area across the upper-left corner could be the underside of a parasol, but lacks visible ribs or a pole and is too cropped to identify, so umbrella is unclear. There is no identifiable board, boat, bag or animal on the beach or horizon. All 75 definitions were considered; the remaining categories have no visible qualifying object.

A cheese pizza with crust sits on a flat plate on a yellow slatted eating table. A fork has clear tines and a handle; the crossing knife has a broad blade and handle. The black cropped vessel at upper right shows a curved body but neither an opening nor an identifiable neck, leaving bottle versus drinking cup unresolved. The flat pizza plate is not a bowl, and toppings do not establish the separately defined fruits or vegetables. Each of the 75 definitions was considered.

An actual child holds a cream plush dog with a long brown floppy ear and protruding muzzle. This is neither a real dog nor a bear-shaped teddy. The child rests among soft white and striped fabric; the crop does not resolve whether the supporting furnishing is a couch or bed, so those two categories remain unclear. No chair or bench structure is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered against the whole crop.

A wired computer mouse is cropped at left, scissors with two finger loops and paired blades lie vertically above center-left, and a metal eating fork enters at lower right. The other large metal implements are hole punches or similar pliers, not scissors or knives; the slim horizontal item near the bottom is a pen. Loose paper is not a bound book, and the work surface is not identifiable as a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real brown bear is clearly identifiable by its head, rounded ears, heavy furred body and clawed paws on grass. It is not a plush toy or costume. The surrounding grass and soil contain no potted plant or other defined object. Each of the 75 definitions was considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real bulldog sits on a black leather couch with upholstered seat and divided back cushions. It holds a black flying disc with a broad circular face and raised rim in its mouth, supporting frisbee identity rather than a dining plate. The orange object is a cushion, not a bag or bed. All 75 definitions were considered and no category ambiguity remains.

The cut wrap shows bread enclosing meat and vegetables, qualifying as a sandwich, on a plated meal at an eating table. The white open vessel at upper right is too cropped to distinguish a drinking cup from a small bowl, so both remain unclear. Flat plates are not bowls. The orange crumbly side does not identify carrot, and the wrap filling does not establish any separately defined fruit or vegetable category. All 75 definitions were considered.

An actual person stands in a kitchen. The left basin and faucet identify a sink; bottles with necks stand on the rear counter. A small plant in a visible pot sits on the left windowsill, while the cut tulips in the foreground white vase count as vase rather than potted plant. The cropped rectangular appliance at far right could be a microwave but does not expose enough door/control detail, so microwave is unclear. Foreground burners alone do not identify an oven. Counters are not dining tables, and stacked wire shapes above the cabinet are not books. All 75 definitions were considered.

The central animal is an actual sheep with a thick wool fleece, black-and-white head and curled horns; another woolly sheep body is partly visible at upper left. Colored marks are paint on the fleece, not accessories or other objects. The grassy field contains no pot or other defined category object. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A chocolate cake slice with crumb and icing sits on a flat plate at an eating table. Fork tines and a handle are visible at the right of the slice, and the metal spoon bowl and stem are visible behind the pale scoop at upper left. The scoop is not another cake or a bowl, and the fork is not a knife. Each of the 75 definitions was considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A square decorated birthday cake with icing and piped edging occupies the crop. Its blue train engine and pink human figure are miniature cake decorations, so they do not count as actual train or person. The gray stone support and tiled backsplash indicate a kitchen counter rather than a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.
